_readme: Ranks a leveling Shaman can skip at the trainer to save gold, by spec. from = the first rank to skip (1 = the whole spell). From the community's Classic leveling guides (noobtoboss.com, zockify.com) adapted to Forever: Enhancement keeps Lightning Bolt (Stormstrike and Maelstrom Weapon boost it) and uses Windfury Weapon from 30. Not tested in Forever. Read by scripts/build-addon.js (the trainer panel in the addon).
